test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Here / come / the bus / for Lucknow.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Come**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the given sentence is the use of the conjugated verb "**come**" i
